name: Admin Accounting Recurring Payments
description: Superuser manages recurring operational costs at /panel/accounting/recurring. Vigentes and Archivados are separate scopes; only active, non-archived rows contribute to monthly totals, participation percentages, charts and upcoming-charge notices, and the interface says so explicitly. In both grouped and classic views a leading three-dots control owns the row actions: detail and history; its note when it has one; edit; duplicate through a non-persisted, prefilled draft whose next charge is recalculated; activate/deactivate; mute or resume reminders; and archive. Archived rows preserve their data, can be restored as inactive, and expose permanent deletion only after typed confirmation. Grouped and classic tables support multi-selection for atomic activate, deactivate and archive actions; duplicate remains one row at a time. The existing category catalog, drag ordering, monthly normalization, currency conversion and category drill-down remain available, while charts always use the budget scope and no longer offer an inactive-row toggle. Registering a real expense/pocket movement and browsing charge history remain a separate accounting-origin scope rather than being inferred by this lifecycle change.
